benchmark: Fashion-MNIST, 500 train samples, 2000 test samples, 15 epochs, averaged over 3 seeds (42, 7, 123)
notes: SAM (rho=0.1) and SGLD both improve val_acc by ~0.4% over Adam baseline.
Lookahead+SGLD achieves the lowest val_loss (0.5407 vs 0.5788 baseline = 6.6% reduction).
All boosters reduce the train/val loss gap (less overfitting), even when val_acc is similar.
On larger datasets (ImageNet, full CIFAR), expected improvement is +0.5-2.0% per the original papers.
